confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Peruvian backpacker-town pricing, not from live listings or inspected booking pages. Restaurant and dorm anchors are moderately reliable. Private hostel and 3-star hotel anchors are less certain because Huacachina accommodation varies widely by property and season. Cocktail and wine are not based on direct price knowledge: cocktail is set at roughly twice the beer anchor and wine is set near the cocktail level, per the local beer-relationship rule. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page; the page itself was not read directly. July is treated as high season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Peru's dune and oasis backpacker circuit, using Ica-region and Paracas/Nazca-style tourist pricing with a premium for tourist-facing bars, hostels and hotels in Huacachina.
